description.value: Shawnigan House Coffee and Chocolate is a specialty coffee and artisan chocolate shop that has been serving the Shawnigan Lake area since 2000. Located on Shawnigan Lake-Mill Bay Road, it offers globally sourced espresso drinks alongside locally handmade truffles and chocolate bars. The menu features a wide range of vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options.

address.value: 1761 Shawnigan Lake-Mill Bay Rd, Shawnigan Lake, BC V0R 2W2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at shawnigancoffee.com is active and confirms the business address, phone, and a detailed menu. The menu page explicitly labels numerous items as Vegan, Vegetarian, and Gluten free, confirming that optional amenity. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all three required criteria unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Duncan' but the physical address and website place the business in Shawnigan Lake, BC — a different community.
